newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan must not continue income tax cut - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan must not continue income tax cut - MOF.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary budget committee on Wednesday that a special income tax cut, implemented for the past three years, must not continue in the fiscal year beginning on April 1.
"Originally, it was government policy to implement the income tax cut for only one year, but the cuts have been extended every year. This must stop from April 1 next year," Mitsuzuka said.
"Continuing the cut would certainly leave the government in debt," Mitsuzuka said.
He added that Japan could work towards steady economic growth only once its budget situation was sound.
